Suggested tokens for the status page:

| Token | Hex |
| Page background | #fbfaf7 |
| Body text | #33312c |
| Muted text | #77726a |
| Accent | #c2571a |

I picked a dark warm grey for the body text instead of true black, because black on a bright background tends to look stark. The contrast ratio is still well above 7:1, so it's accessible, and the muted grey stays above 4.5:1 for small labels. If the page has a dark theme variant later, mirror the same idea there: soft off-white text rather than pure white, so the two themes feel consistent.
